name: Sustained
what: Environmental footprint software for food products and manufacturers (formerly a consumer sustainability-score app).

membership.basis: Listed on visionaries.vc/portfolio in the 2023 capture only. No round announcement, firm post or register entry naming Visionaries was found; the company's registers show founders only.
membership.quote: Sustained is on a mission to empower consumers to make choices

notes: Legal entity per the site's privacy policy: Unimagined Limited (Companies House 12877614, incorporated 2020-09-13, London). Its only allotment is 2020-11-17 (capital GBP 4,500) and every confirmation statement since says 'no updates'; the 2023 accounts name a parent 'Unimagined Group OÜ' (Estonia, reg. 16094492), whose register shows only the founders Mihails Velenko (55%) and Carl Stefke Olivier (45%), with a deletion notice; the operating OÜ (16097409) is 100% owned by the group. So no fund appears on any cap table found; a Visionaries SAFE or convertible that never converted, or an angel/partner check, cannot be ruled out. Searched: Google News '"Sustained" Velenko', '"Sustained" food footprint startup', '"Sustained" food sustainability raises' -> nothing; web search -> nothing. Company operating (site live 2026, UK accounts to 2025-09). Founders Carl Olivier (CEO) and Michael (Mihails) Velenko (CTO, Tallinn); TechNation Climate 2024 cohort.
